name: THWACK!

description.content: When the trial starts, you earn [3] Tokens, up to [3].
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn [1] Token.
Wenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend [1] Token. Then, all Survivors within [36m] scream and you see their Auras for [6s].

quote: "All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!" -Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3
